description: This PHP file implements a web page for changing user passwords within a web UI. It includes HTML markup, embedded PHP for server-side logic, JavaScript for client-side validation and interactivity, and external includes for common page elements such as headers, user bar, navigation, and footer.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the instance number based on the current logged-in user.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to 'at_a_glance.php' when canceling password change.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends a configuration JSON to the server to update the password, then handles success or failure responses with alerts and redirect.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password inputs and initiates password change process by calling set_config.
